correctness.rationale: Convexity of pairwise electrical resistance justifies exact automorphism averaging for every connected feasible allocation. Direct exact reduced-Laplacian inversions (144 comparisons), phase comparisons (108), and three symbolic identities passed. Finite checks are supplementary.

value.rationale: The exact all-m classification resolves a natural worst-pair electrical design problem with a perfect-matching surcharge. Four genuine regimes distinguish bottleneck vertex-pair types and edge screening; the narrow interior regime has the nontrivial sharp scale 1/(2m^2). The resistor-network optimum deletes matching edges at a price strictly lower than the distinct algebraic-connectivity objective, making the exact threshold mathematically informative.
